10.old: FVREB reports White Rock and South Surrey as one area and publishes a benchmark price, median sale price, sales and active listings for townhouses every month. Days to sell are published for the whole Fraser Valley only.
10.new: Every month FVREB publishes townhouse figures for White Rock and South Surrey combined as a single area: active listings, sales, median sale price and benchmark price. Days to sell are only published for the Fraser Valley as a whole.

26.old: Ask for the Form B Information Certificate, the bylaws, recent minutes, the budget and the depreciation report. Under the Strata Property Act, the strata must provide the Form B within one week.
26.new: Request the Form B Information Certificate, plus the budget, the depreciation report, recent minutes and the bylaws. The Strata Property Act requires the strata to hand over the Form B within one week.

28.old: Not anymore. Since November 2022, BC strata bylaws can no longer ban or limit rentals. Age limits for 55+ buildings are still allowed.
28.new: No, not any longer. As of November 2022, strata bylaws in BC cannot ban or restrict rentals, though age limits for 55+ buildings are still permitted.

30.old: BC has a home buyer rescission period. You have three business days after acceptance to cancel, and you pay the seller 0.25% of the purchase price if you do.
30.new: Buyers in BC get a rescission period. Within three business days of acceptance you can cancel, but doing so costs you 0.25% of the purchase price, paid to the seller.
